_readme: The app's icon library. Every icon the Feature Type editor offers, and every icon the map and the PDF draw, comes from this folder. Each entry maps a file name (<name>.svg here) to the words it can be searched by. _groups decides how the picker is laid out: Favorites first, then Common, then Other — which is collapsed by default. To add an icon: drop the .svg in here, add it to "icons" with some keywords, and list it in one of the groups.
